_readme: Template profile. See TEMPLATE.md. Keys starting with _ are comments.
_icon: Window and taskbar icon (.svg, .png or .ico), relative to the project root. Empty = Qt default.
_pages: Navigation order. Remove a key to hide that page. Built-ins: workflow, operations_menu, dashboard, devices, connections, packet_monitor, test_bench, porting, database, logs, settings. Plugin pages not listed here are appended at the end.
_plugins: Python modules with a register(registry) function (create one with tools/new_page.py).
_menu_hooks: Python modules whose @menu_option functions appear on the Operations Menu page (see plugins/example_menu.py).
_workflow_operations: Step 4 of the Session Workflow: 'operations' (fixed operations from command sets) or 'menu' (the Operations Menu's hooks).
_sql_dirs: Folders whose *.sql files define named queries (loaded after the built-ins; same name overrides).
_theme: Colour overrides: background, panel, input, border, text, text_dim, accent, accent_dim, ok, warning, error, rx, tx
